name: credits-dot-number
title: Credits dot number
description: A dot-grid number that transitions to Doto text and back.
usage: The free credits figure in the closing call to action (`value="1,000"`) and step numbers (`value="1" morphTo="PLAN" sideColumns={0}`). It is decorative: keep the figure in text beside it.
avoid: A dot number as the only copy of a figure
Digits it does not draw (it draws 0 to 3 and the comma)

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
